result.title: CounterSketch: Physics-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Sketch-to-Video Generation
result.summary: Counterfactual sketch animation explores how a static sketch evolves under a hypothetical intervention. We present CounterSketch, a physics-grounded framework that transforms natural-language ``What if...?'' queries into physically plausible sketch animations. The framework integrates VLM-guided scene grounding, causal event-chain reasoning, constraint-based trajectory generation, and verification. It models physical transitions to update the scene graph, computes continuous object trajectories, and validates them against physical, geometric, and semantic constraints. The verified trajectories are then projected into object-level motion bounding boxes to guide downstream sketch-video synthesis. Experiments on CounterSketchBench (80 questions) demonstrate that physics-grounded trajectories provide stronger motion guidance than direct VLM predictions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CounterSketch 框架，将「What if...?」式反事实查询转化为物理合理的草图动画：先用 VLM 做场景落地与因果事件链推理，再生成并校验约束下的物体轨迹，投影为运动框以指导草图视频合成。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于草图到视频的生成管线，推理体现为文本事件链与下游轨迹约束，未涉及 VLM 内部视觉状态表示、latent 推理状态或证据筛选与停止决策的分析，与 LVR 主线缺乏具体联系。
